author: SadFart64
quote:
Really sad to see how each GTA ALWAYS had a huge, industry changing feature that made other games follow...
GTA 4 arguably popularized the OpenWorld to a point where every game is a sandbox with some twist...
GTA 5 Introduced character swapping on the fly and brought GTA Online which was what really made the industry look at live service...
GTA 6... Well, it introduced mass chores and... it looks pretty?

What took 13 years, but could've been done through a modding team of 12 over 3 years in the GTA 5 map...
I have a nice PC (as of recently) so I know how good GTA 5 CAN look, and its about the same as i see at 20 -30 FPS on console.
I mean this genuinely, I've installed world changing mods in GTA 5 that aren't that hard or intensive, and while it's similar, the experience isn't close enough to GTA 5 to feel board all over, but it's also pretty damn close to 6 where I don't understand where the time and money went...

Is it good, eh, not story wise, but when a bunch of undeniably hyper-feminist/leftist women write the story, it's to be expected, but to the level it's at, it's almost vomit inducing at times. 
It's clear the Narrative team was fully left to their own devices so that HR wouldn't get overloaded with complaints of misogyny when the player base is no lie 80-20 male...
Just look at what Kratos' voice actor said from God of War (Paraphrase): Why do we iterate on success, by getting rid of the people that brought about the success in the first place? It doesn't make sense to tell someone who is the reason people love the story of soul ****: "Well that just doesn't work for us anymore" (In useless HR lady voice)
God, get a clue people, this game was meant to humiliate men, not tell a good story like it used to, and in the meantime distract good men with false promises
